timeline.title: Bosch weighs first bonus issue in ~40 years
timeline.line: Board meets today on a bonus issue and share split; the stock is near record levels
more: Last bonus was in 1986; last split in 2004
Shares rose about 9% over three sessions on the plan
Ratios and record date not yet disclosed
